#define utstring_append_len(dst, src, len)                                    \
do {                                                                           \
    while ((dst)->n-(dst)->i <= (len)) utstring_reserve((dst),((dst)->n)*2);   \
    memcpy(&(dst)->d[(dst)->i], (src), (len));                                 \
    (dst)->i+=(len);                                                           \
    (dst)->d[(dst)->i]='\0';                                                   \
} while(0)
